summary: This zone is Bali Zero's library of 34 Claude Code subagent definitions, organized into ~8 coherent subsystems: the WR2 carousel pipeline (orchestrator + 6 workers + 2 analysts + 1 external bench), the WR3 video pipeline (orchestrator + 8 workers + 2 analysts + bench + reflexion), and standalone agents for research, HR, CRM-revenue, brand-email, competitor-intel, and infra-verify. WR2 is in real production (33 carousel output dirs, 15-row episodic log, live cron stack); WR3 reached pilot stage only (5 episode dirs, no episodic log, one missing runner binary); several standalone cron agents (competitor-monitor, yield-optimizer) are defined and LaunchAgent-loaded but have produced zero runtime artifacts.

gaps: Quoting clients by hand: client-case-quote-generator is ROTTO (no PricingTool in toolset → prices from user-input/DeepSeek; uses deprecated deepseek-reasoner that silently downgrades to flash). Bali Zero still hand-builds A4 quotes because the agent can't be trusted to send-ready (FROZEN S3 verdict 0/3). GAP: a PricingTool-grounded, v4-pro-math quote agent.

DeepSeek model-id rot across 4 agents (client-case-quote-generator, deep-researcher, devils-advocate, wr2-external-bench) still call 'deepseek-reasoner'/'DeepSeek Reasoner' — CLAUDE.md documents this as a TRAP that returns deepseek-v4-flash silently (lower quality) instead of deepseek-v4-pro. None migrated to explicit deepseek-v4-pro. Bali Zero's red-team/math/synthesis quality is silently degraded.

Competitor intelligence is fully manual: competitor-monitor (Lets Move / Emerhub / Flado) is MAI_USATO — cron loaded but research/competitive/ never created. No one is systematically tracking the 3 direct competitors' pricing/positioning; it's ad-hoc.

Revenue/upsell scanning is manual: yield-optimizer (KITAS-expiring / KITAP-eligible / dormant-high-value CRM scan) is MAI_USATO — research/commercial/ never created. Renewal & upsell opportunities are spotted by humans, not the agent that exists for it.

WR3 video production has no maintainer for its bench: wr3-editorial-bench cron entry-point binary (~/.openclaw/bin/wr3/wr3-editorial-bench-run.sh) is MISSING while its plist is loaded (same RED 'binary_missing' class as recent organism-audit findings). And the whole WR3 pipeline never reached steady-state (no episodic-log) — every WR3 episode is effectively hand-run as a pilot.

frontend-browser cannot actually do its job autonomously: its `tools` list includes no browser MCP (only Read/Bash/WebFetch), and it references mcp__playwright which project CLAUDE.md bans by default — so deploy visual-QA still falls to a human or to the operator's interactive claude-in-chrome session, not this agent.

No agent covers CRM mutation/Guardian: client-case-quote-generator's own footer says 'Update the client's CRM (out of scope; CRM-Guardian agent — TBD)'. CRM record hygiene/linking after a quote or onboarding is unautomated at the agent layer.

hr-companion's knowledge substrate (employee-handbook-v1-ID.html, pkwtt-template-master.html) is unverified on disk — if missing, every HR answer that must 'cite Bab/Pasal' has no source, so HR lookups still happen by hand against the real documents.

summary: 8 deterministic multi-step "autopilot" workflow chains exposed as MCP tools by the nuzantara-mcp server: each chains 5-8 sequential HTTP calls to the backend-rag API (CRM, intel, compliance, journey, analytics, comms) with IF/THEN branching, notification dedup, optional NotebookLM grounding, and LAM reflection — no LLM in the loop.
